subject.title: Add plan-first Claw status and remove

question: Should `claws remove` retain globally installed plugins while releasing only the Claw reference, and rely on retained partial provenance instead of writing a permanent redacted removal tombstone?
rationale: This is a durable operator and data-lifecycle contract, not a mechanical defect: the current proposal intentionally chooses one behavior while review discussion requests another.

options.title: Confirm scoped retention policy
options.body: Keep shared plugins installed, allow only safe final-reference workspace-skill removal, and retain partial provenance for status/retry without a permanent tombstone.

options.title: Require a removal tombstone
options.body: Add a redacted persistent post-removal record so operators can inspect the removed Claw's former role and resources after active rows are cleaned up.

options.title: Pause lifecycle removal
options.body: Defer this removal slice until the RFC or owner decision defines the required audit and cleanup contract.

recommendation.title: Confirm scoped retention policy
recommendation.body: Keep shared plugins installed, allow only safe final-reference workspace-skill removal, and retain partial provenance for status/retry without a permanent tombstone.

likelyOwner.reason: Their review comment identifies the unresolved lifecycle-policy boundary directly.
